claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Quell describes its product as a UAT AI agent platform that automates UAT, identifies bugs, and checks builds against acceptance criteria.
claims.quote: Quell is UAT AI Agent building and tasking platform that automates UAT and identifies bugs ensuring your builds meet your acceptance criteria.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Quell states that its AI reads designs, tickets, or requirements and writes tests without scripting.
claims.quote: No scripting needed – Quell’s AI reads your designs, tickets, or requirements and writes the tests for you.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Quell says it executes tests automatically when an issue or ticket status changes in tools such as Linear or Jira.
claims.quote: Quell executes tests upon issue or ticket status changes (e.g. Linear or Jira).

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Quell includes human approval steps by letting team members be tagged for launch approvals.
claims.quote: Tag team members, gain launch approvals.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Quell claims audit readiness through video and screenshot documentation.
claims.quote: Audit ready with video and screenshot documentation

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: A testimonial says Quell’s automatic screenshots and short videos attached to each test are very clear.
claims.quote: Quell's automatic screenshots and short videos attached to each test are very clear

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Quell claims every requirement is validated and documented, and that its UAT reports support compliance audits.
claims.quote: Every requirement is validated and documented . Quell’s UAT reports support your compliance audits.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Quell positions its AI as embedded in existing tools such as Slack, Jira, Linear, and Figma.
claims.quote: Quell integrates with the tools you already use (Slack, Jira, Linear, Figma).
